transform.definition: For each scene entity x:=960-x, y unchanged; stable IDs/kinds/counts/rules/order retained. Every requested coordinate x becomes960-x; runtime input vector dx negated, dy unchanged.
transform.geometryJustification: Rectangle reflection preserves all center distances/contact thresholds and relative layout; reflect all participants together. AI side is never transformed.
identityRules: Materialize each mirrored projectId as sourceProjectId+'-mirror' and independent actual run IDs; retain source fixture and transform hash references. ProjectId-only changes do not change semanticHash; mirrored scene geometry still uses its own canonically recomputed semanticHash.
Never mirror/rename an already captured event to manufacture evidence; actually execute the mirrored document/input.
Second repeat resets the same variant to its locked initial state; retain prior familiarity as limitation.
Content instructions coordinate mentions must be transformed where present; rules/values and target goals stay equivalent.

terminalConflictMirror.rule: Actual execution only; never transform previously captured actual events as a substitute.

roles.agentExecutionSource: machine_browser_input/automation_test or catalog_machine; cannot supply human judgment
roles.assignmentPolicy: Actual human and consent/scope reference required at collection; user is internal, never label independent_non_developer.

materials: same frozen scene/rules/registry/catalog facts and current program help
same15-minute side window; assistance available equally and logged
sharedConditions.aiOnlyAddition: real approved AI using the existing38 slots; no extra comparison calls
record: actual operator identity/source and prior experience
start/end timestamps and active author/support/wait/preparation durations separately
operation count, requests/attempts/latency, actual costs/unknown reservations
actually offered distinct executable directions and human choice/reject/retain
event citation existence/version/values; facts vs hypotheses; next verifiable step
support/equivalent/extra burden/worse/missing evidence with concrete source links
limits: Single adult/internal observations only; no child learning, general usability, adoption or model reliability claims.
Repeated task/order effects remain limitations; mirror/ABBA do not establish causal educational benefit.
sharedConditions.nonModelSemantics: B is judged by author goals, retained constraints, actual manual decisions/final document/run and measured burden. B need not emit AI result kinds, directions/explanation DTOs, child requests, candidate trials or one-batch revision semantics; existing manual command validation still applies.
